sa_r6-sa109_skateboard.desc: skateboard side view, 70.2 x 16.1 — the sheet's 10 mm grid inset outline filled (PDF vector strokes of the inset, not a raster trace of the sign, where the slash covers it)

sa_r6-sa109_skate.desc: in-line skate, 53.7 x 37.8 — from the 10 mm grid inset outline, filled

sa_r6-sa109_scooter.desc: kick scooter, 49.3 x 50.1 — from the 10 mm grid inset outline, filled between its inner and outer outlines (wheel rings open)

notes: DIT SA Standard Road Sign Index sheet (A4, legends and dimensions outlined, colour legend; size from the sheet's size table = register). Every dimension from the sheet; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. Sheet R6-SA110 (2025, 1:5): R6-SA110AA illustrated, drawn 225 x 210 (the size table says 225 x 260, the register 225 x 210; A 450 x 450), R10, white, no outer border. The sheet's vertical chain reads 98 / 10 / 90 / 12 (= 210), but the sign is drawn 10 / 90 / 10 / 90 / 10 (rings measured at y 9.9-100.7 and 109.3-200.1): drawn as the drawing, the 98 and 12 taken as typing errors. Three red prohibition rings 90 dia (ring and slash 7.5 wide, measured — not dimensioned; slash from upper right to lower left over the symbol): skateboard on top (centred, 67.5/90/67.5), in-line skate and scooter below (15 / 90 / 15 / 90 / 15, the sheet's 98 | 98 from the ring edges to the sign's centre line). Pictograms from the sheet's 10 mm grid inset (outlines filled; skateboard 70 x 16, skate 54 x 38, scooter 49 x 50), placed where the sign shows them (measured). The sign draws a hairline white keyline round each pictogram part (CAD outline) — not reproduced.
